scenario_selection: All four locked scenes; first predetermined environment seed20000, without trajectory ranking.
comparison_scope: Standard PPO360k seed0, validation-selected fixed beam3, causal-feedback scheme4 TS adaptation. Offline budgets and history state differ; one-trajectory videos do not replace all-policy/all-environment statistics.

playback.sampling: Uniform 7/8-slot jumps; only selected-slot action shown; intermediate actions omitted.

metric_definitions.cumulative_throughput: Completed bits from slots500..current inclusive / elapsed simulated postwarmup seconds; older arrivals completed after warmup are included.
metric_definitions.pending_fraction: Postservice queue / all cumulative arrivals through displayed slot, not packet loss.
metric_definitions.aggregation: One seed trajectory, not a multi-seed mean.

visual_semantics.geometry_blockage_pathloss: Actual pre-step fields. Source copies service-used Pathloss before position/pathloss update; displayed geometry follows that timing.
visual_semantics.map_padding: Display-only projection box y370..585 reserves 29px marker/beam clearance from the map label and caption; all post-warmup recorded positions checked.
visual_semantics.solid_arrow: Recorded AP attempt to relay or direct UE, not guaranteed delivery.
visual_semantics.purple_dashed_arrow: Actual active D2D link this slot from previous recorded action.
visual_semantics.orange_dashed_arrow: Recorded relay-to-target plan for next slot, not simultaneous delivery.
visual_semantics.beam_wedge: Actual codebook TX width; central direction is schematic, not recorded steering.
visual_semantics.blockage: Actual simulator blocked links only; no invented physical blockers.
visual_semantics.nodes: UE1..5 map source0..4; nearby markers shrink without changing actual positions.

resource_use: Stream one frame at a time; retain only first/mid/end source frames; handle one scene's three traces at a time. Encoder/decoder codec thread limits <=2; filter threads1.
visual_qa_status: Completed agent inspection of all four scenes: source and decoded frames 0,100,199 (24 PNGs). The map-label contact found in V1 is resolved; methods, metrics, actions, queue bars, captions and encoded frames remain legible. Truly adjacent AP/UE markers can overlap because recorded coordinates are kept exact; action text and all five queue labels remain explicit.

visual_qa.review_type: Codex agent visual inspection; not a human-read or hardware-validation attestation
checks: Chinese titles and budget disclosures fit
Metrics and queue labels remain legible
Sampled actions and queue curves change across time
Map markers remain clear of the label and lower caption
Source and decoded key frames preserve the same visible content
known_display_limitations: The AP and nearby UE4 overlap at the start of shift13; positions are not moved for display, and the explicit route/queue labels identify the user.
The beam width is from the recorded codebook, but central steering direction is schematic.
Only 200 uniformly sampled slots are shown; intermediate actions are omitted.
